title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go, parity fixes, version bumps
author: Priya Gupta
description:
Motivation: Bring Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs into parity for auth and retry semantics, improve streaming ergonomics (cancellation / backpressure handling), and publish minor patch version bumps. This unblocks a number of people-team customers who observed different retry semantics across SDKs and resolves flaky streaming cancellation observed in Dedicated environments.

Summary of changes: - Standardize token refresh + edge-case 401 handling across SDKs (immediately refresh and retry once, then surface a clear error). - Introduce a lightweight, shared retry policy spec (idempotency-aware) implemented in each SDK. - Streaming ergonomics: add explicit Stream.cancel()/close() helpers, surface early user-facing errors, and ensure background goroutines/tasks are cleaned up on client shutdown. - Parity fixes: align default timeouts, backoff multipliers, and connection pooling. - Version bumps: python v1.80.1, typescript v1.80.1, go v1.80.1. - Docs and changelog updates and new unit/integration tests.

Migration: No breaking changes for existing users. Library defaults are unchanged for most parameters except a small tweak to default stream cleanup timeout (reduced from 30s to 5s) to avoid lingering background tasks; this is a non-breaking behavioral improvement but called out in release notes.

Testing and QA: - Added unit tests for retry policy in all three SDKs. - Added integration test that exercises token refresh during a streaming session. - Ran internal e2e against Dedicated and hosted endpoints; reproduced prior flaky streaming cancellation and verified fix.

Rollout plan: - Cut patch release immediately after merge. - Monitor streaming/error SLOs and SDK error telemetry for 48 hours. - If we see a spike in token-refresh errors we will rollback to previous client in server-side routing for affected customers.

Checklist: - [x] Tests added/updated - [x] Docs updated - [x] Changelog entry - [x] Reviewed by SDK leads - [x] Verified on Dedicated staging

Notes: This PR is intentionally cross-language; separate commits implement the same retry/spec with minimal language-specific plumbing. See commit summary below for per-SDK details.

release_notes:
- sdks: unify auth/retries across Python/TypeScript/Go; standardize token refresh and single automatic retry on 401.
- sdks: improve streaming ergonomics (Stream.cancel()/close(), faster cleanup).
- sdks: parity fixes for timeouts and backoff multipliers.
- patch release: python v1.80.1, typescript v1.80.1, go v1.80.1.
